visual_identity.core_identity: A colossal subterranean worm whose immense segmented body and circular tooth-filled maw can fill an entire mine tunnel.
visual_identity.silhouette: Huge cylindrical segmented body emerging straight through tunnel space, front dominated by round open maw.
visual_identity.head_features: No separate skull; front is a circular muscular mouth ringed with inward-pointing teeth.
visual_identity.body_shape: Extremely thick worm body with repeated broad segments and long unseen continuation into tunnel.
visual_identity.surface: Large simple segmented plates or folds; minimal fine texture.

accuracy_checks: scale is obvious from tunnel geometry

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.
